newsitem.title: UK: BFI up six as Atlantic Panamaxes firm further.
newsitem.headline: BFI up six as Atlantic Panamaxes firm further.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up six to 1,343 points on Friday aqnd brokers reported very firm conditions for Panamaxes in the Atlantic.
Following Cargill's fixture of Torm Tekla for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Japan for July/August at $23.50 no combo these charterers were said to be firm at $24.00 no combo for July 14/20.
Dreyfus were rumoured to have fixed prompt South Korean tonnage in this trade either $24.00 and $24.25 no combo.
Egyptian and Chinese charterers continued to be active in the Panamax grain and fertiliser trades.
Brokers said Panamax markets remained firm in the Pacific where Dreyfus fixed the Panocean relet Beskydy for 54,000 heavy grain Nopac to Taiwan for mid-July at $13.55.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was between 15 and 20 points higher and turnover totalled 123 lots.
